flagged.Balin: Real surname (e.g. Marty Balin) and a town in Poland
flagged.Dain: English given name (e.g. Hammett's 'The Dain Curse')
flagged.Dís: Old Norse word for a female spirit (plural dísir), used in English writing on mythology
flagged.Gimli: Real town in Manitoba, Canada, and a hall in Norse mythology
flagged.Kili: Kili Island in the Marshall Islands, and a short name for Kilimanjaro
flagged.Nain: Biblical town and a town in Labrador; also Scots and Welsh words
flagged.Nali: Real given name and surname, and a transliterated Hindi/Urdu word ('nali', drain or tube) seen in English text
flagged.Nar: Nar River in Italy, and the abbreviation NAR
flagged.Rukhs: Plural of rukh, a variant of roc (mythical bird) and of the chess rook
